newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P affirms Swire "A",rates perpetual bond A-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Swire "A",rates perpetual bond A-minus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's rating agnecy on Wednesday said it affirmed its "A" long-term corporate credit rating on Swire Pacific Ltd.

The agency also said it assigned an A-minus rating to the US$300 million Cumulative Guaranteed Pertetual Capital Securities issued by Swire Pacific Offshore Financing Ltd and guaranteed on a subordinated basis by Swire Pacific Ltd.
Standard and Poor's said the lower rating reflected the subordination and interest deferral option of the Securities.
